note: Core baseline recorded in S03. Numbers compare only on this machine. Each metric is the last of 3 runs; medianRangeOf3Runs shows the spread of the median over all 3 runs. The fake back end has no search cost: P4 measures the use case itself, not a real search. P3-poll1ms depends on the Windows timer resolution, which is a system-wide state.
method: P1: 9 repetitions of 2 000 000 calls (500 000 for the enabled probe), first repetition dropped; P2: 300 jobs, first 20 dropped, 2 ms pause between jobs; P3: 100 cancels, first 10 dropped; P4: 23 runs, first 3 dropped
